title: Create listings from advertising enquiries
changes: Added a Wagtail action to create a draft listing from an enquiry. It fills in the business name and location and links the listing to the enquiry's reply email.
The inbox marks converted enquiries and links back to the listing. The listing follows the existing approval and payment process.

title: Advertiser payment page and live Stripe support
changes: Added a dedicated monthly and annual payment page for approved advertisers, using the prices in Wagtail.
Added live Stripe support. Public paid listings require payment confirmation in the configured billing mode.

title: Release notes in Django admin
changes: Added a release history for superusers with the running version, dates and a summary of each change.
Recorded the original site and subsequent changes in a changelog that ships with the app.

title: Consistent styling across EA600
changes: Unified page introductions, cards, buttons and the compact footer across the public site.
Kept the scenic Home and Advertise heroes and moved the homepage photo strip above the footer.

title: Shared navigation and jump links
changes: Added one responsive header and visible current-section highlights.
Adjusted section, itinerary and enquiry links to land below the sticky header.

title: Three-day and fourteen-day EA600 routes
changes: Published both itineraries in the route planner and Explore routes, with editable stops, day descriptions and map pins.

title: Advertiser page refresh
changes: Redesigned the public advertiser pages and added editable guidance on eligibility, listing benefits and enquiries.
Kept one listing package with monthly and annual payment options.

title: Editable advertising prices
changes: Let Wagtail editors set the prices for new monthly and annual checkouts. Existing renewals retain their agreed prices.

title: Checkout prices visible in Wagtail
changes: Showed the active monthly and annual prices in the Advertise page settings.

title: Configurable Advertise page and enquiries
changes: Moved advertiser page copy, form labels, field order and custom questions into Wagtail settings.

title: Advertising enquiries
changes: Added a public enquiry form and a private Wagtail inbox for reviewing and replying to submissions.

title: Business listing pilot and reporting
changes: Added ten fictional businesses and 30-day reporting for website, booking and directions clicks.

title: Partner applications and test subscriptions
changes: Added email sign-in, listing applications, staff approval and Stripe test checkout for monthly or annual subscriptions.

title: Business listings at route stops
changes: Added Wagtail-managed listings for local businesses and placed published cards beside relevant tour stops.

title: Homepage route picker
changes: Let visitors switch the homepage map, stops and itinerary between published tours.

title: Interactive route maps
changes: Added GPX imports, interactive maps and geographic stop placement in Tour Builder.

title: Explore routes catalogue
changes: Made published routes easier to browse through the homepage and the Explore routes page.

title: Stronger editor sign-in
changes: Required authenticator codes for editor accounts and limited repeated password and verification attempts.

title: Image processing dependency update
changes: Upgraded Pillow to include fixes for image processing security advisories.

title: Tour Builder links from Django admin
changes: Added Tour Builder links for users with the relevant tour permissions.

title: Wagtail link from Django admin
changes: Added a shortcut to Wagtail for users with Wagtail access.

title: Preview deployment for editor access
changes: Triggered a preview deployment for editor account provisioning.

title: Photo previews in Wagtail
changes: Displayed thumbnails of selected photos on Wagtail editing screens.

title: Shared Wagtail photo library
changes: Made the EA600 photo library available in Wagtail for browsing and uploads.

title: Site content and tour publishing controls
changes: Added Wagtail controls for the homepage, branding, planning tips, stories, FAQs and contact details.
Added controls for unpublishing and deleting tours in Tour Builder.

title: Tour Builder
changes: Added an editor for creating, previewing and publishing tours with ordered stops, itinerary days and photographs.

title: Editable homepage destinations
changes: Added Wagtail editing for destination cards, photos and links on the homepage.

title: Wagtail 8.1
changes: Upgraded the content management system to Wagtail 8.1.

title: Wagtail destination guides
changes: Added public guides and editable layouts for text, photos and featured tours.

title: Editable tours and site content
changes: Imported the original route and homepage copy into Django so staff could edit stops, itinerary days and photos.

title: Railway Django preview
changes: Configured the Django app to run on Railway and serve its static assets.

title: Django application foundation
changes: Converted the existing EA600 landing page to a Django project with its original content and assets.

title: Retired the original server script
changes: Removed the Node server script from the static site.

title: Retired the original package configuration
changes: Removed the Node package configuration from the static site.

title: Original tagged EA600 website
changes: Added the full static site design with route information, destinations, itinerary, planning sections and photography.

title: First EA600 website
changes: Added the first static landing page and a simple web server for Railway.

title: EA600 repository created
changes: Added the initial project README.
